body.statement: Let \(U\subseteq\mathbb R^m\) be open, let \(a:U\to\mathbb R^q\) be continuously differentiable, and let \(b:U\to\mathbb R^k\) be continuous. If \(b(x)=b(x')\) implies \(a(x)=a(x')\), then \(\operatorname{rank}Da(x)\le k\) for every \(x\in U\).
body.justification: This lemma removes the unjustified differentiation of the induced map while preserving the published hypotheses.
body.gap: Prashant et al.'s Appendix applies a chain rule to an induced map whose differentiability is not stated.
body.consumer: The restricted separator upper bound uses this lemma for every population query issued by RankPeel.
